content:
{'報道提到，朱鎔基病重期間，習近平和李強等領導人都曾前往醫院探望；朱鎔基逝世後，亦以各種形式表示沉痛哀悼，並向其親屬表示深切慰問。新華社報道朱鎔基告別儀式消息的第一稿，未有刊登告別式的現場相片，在其後更新內容才加入習近平與朱鎔基親屬握手的相片。': "The report mentioned that during Zhu Rongji's serious illness, leaders including Xi Jinping and Li Qiang visited him in hospital; after Zhu Rongji's death, [the leadership] also expressed deep condolences in various forms and conveyed sincere sympathy to his relatives. The first version of Xinhua's report on Zhu Rongji's farewell ceremony did not include on-site photos of the ceremony; photos of Xi Jinping shaking hands with Zhu Rongji's relatives were added only in subsequent updates."}

{'此外，在朱鎔基告別儀式舉行期間，北京市的保安措施亦較李克強時加強。根據路透、台灣《中央社》和《東森新聞》等媒體報道，早上八時許，天安門附近已出現相信是載著朱鎔基遺體的靈車，向八寶山方向駛去。': "In addition, security measures in Beijing during Zhu Rongji's farewell ceremony were tightened compared with the time of Li Keqiang's. According to reports by Reuters, Taiwan's Central News Agency and EBC News, shortly after 8 a.m. a hearse believed to be carrying Zhu Rongji's remains appeared near Tiananmen, heading toward Babaoshan."}

{'市民未能在路邊向靈車揮手送別': 'Citizens unable to bid farewell to the hearse from the roadside'}

{'從天安門至八寶山的沿途，早上7時許已實施交通管制，並有多部警車及便衣人員在不同地點駐守。在舉行告別儀式的八寶山站，早上實施管制，在八寶山附近的幾公里，不僅路上停泊了特警車，在街道上和行人天橋上，都有大批身穿黑衣的便衣人員駐守，行人難以在路邊聚集和停留，便衣亦會驅散在路上停留的民眾，直至約十時許才解封。市民未能如李克強火化當日一樣，在靈車駛往八寶山的途中，站在路邊向靈車揮手送別。市民只能改在網上留言悼念朱鎔基，在新華社和央視的報道留言區，有大批網民留言表示哀悼，包括留言「朱總理一路好走」和 「深切緬懷」，或以貼上小蠟燭的圖案示意悼念。': 'Along the route from Tiananmen to Babaoshan, traffic control was imposed shortly after 7 a.m., with police vehicles and plainclothes officers stationed at various points. At Babaoshan, where the farewell ceremony was held, control was implemented in the morning; within several kilometres of the area, not only were SWAT vehicles parked along the road, but large numbers of plainclothes officers in black were stationed on streets and pedestrian overpasses, making it difficult for pedestrians to gather or stop by the roadside. Plainclothes officers also dispersed people lingering on the street, and the cordon was lifted only around 10 a.m. Unlike on the day of Li Keqiang\'s cremation, citizens were unable to stand by the roadside and wave the hearse off as it travelled to Babaoshan. They could only post messages online to mourn Zhu Rongji; in the comment sections of Xinhua and CCTV\'s reports, a large number of netizens left condolence messages, including "Premier Zhu, have a safe journey" and "Deeply cherish the memory of," or posted images of small candles to express mourning.'}

{'雖然民間難以在沿途送別朱鎔基，但官方則安排在他遺體火化日清晨，於北京天安門下半旗。另外，新華門、人民大會堂和外交部等北京重要機構亦有下半旗。在香港和澳門的政府總部、禮賓府和機場等出入境口岸，亦為悼念朱鎔基下半旗。': 'Although the public found it difficult to see Zhu off along the route, the authorities arranged for flags at Tiananmen in Beijing to be flown at half-mast on the morning of the day his remains were cremated. Important Beijing institutions including Xinhuamen, the Great Hall of the People, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs also lowered their flags to half-mast. Government headquarters, Government House, and immigration control points such as airports in Hong Kong and Macau also flew flags at half-mast in mourning for Zhu Rongji.'}

{'「鐵面總理」、「經濟沙皇」': "'Iron-faced Premier', 'Economic Tsar'"}

{'回顧朱鎔基的一生，除了「鐵面總理」和「經濟沙皇」等稱號外，他言談風趣幽默，能言善辯，在1999年到美國進行國事訪問，他與美國前總統克林頓共見記者，接受國際傳媒的現場提問，回應中美關係、人權和台灣問題等問題，為外界留下深刻印象。': 'Looking back on Zhu Rongji\'s life, beyond titles such as "Iron-faced Premier" and "Economic Tsar," he was witty, humorous, and articulate. During his 1999 state visit to the United States, he appeared with former US president Bill Clinton before the press, taking live questions from international media on issues including China-US relations, human rights, and Taiwan, leaving a deep impression on the outside world.'}

{'「義無反顧，鞠躬盡瘁，死而後已」': "'No turning back, giving all until one's last breath'"}

{'朱鎔基在任期間也留下許多的「金句」。在1998年兩會接替李鵬擔任總理後，首次出席中外記者會時曾表示：「不管前面是地雷陣還是萬丈深淵，我都將一往無前，義無反顧，鞠躬盡瘁，死而後已。」為顯示自己反腐敗倡議的決心，他亦曾表明：「我準備了一百口棺材，九十九口給貪官，一口留給自己。」連「豆腐渣工程」一詞，也是他在 1998 年到江西視察水災災情時提出。': 'Zhu Rongji also left behind many memorable quotes during his time in office. After succeeding Li Peng as premier at the Two Sessions in 1998, he said at his first press conference for Chinese and foreign journalists: "No matter whether there is a field of landmines ahead or an abyss, I will press forward without hesitation, never look back, devote all my efforts, and persevere until I die." To demonstrate his resolve in championing the anti-corruption cause, he once declared: "I have prepared a hundred coffins — ninety-nine for corrupt officials, and one for myself." Even the term "tofu-dreg project" was coined by him during his 1998 inspection of flood-hit areas in Jiangxi.'}

{'每天閱讀兩份香港報紙 朱鎔基長期關注香港，也使他成為最熟悉香港的國家領導人之一。他與香港的聯繫，早於 1990 年擔任上海市長期間已經開始。他當年率領經貿代表團到香港考察，此後至退休前一共四次訪港。他亦非常關注香港情況，每天閱讀兩份香港報紙，了解香港最新情況。': "Reading two Hong Kong newspapers every day. Zhu Rongji's long-standing attention to Hong Kong also made him one of the national leaders most familiar with the city. His connection with Hong Kong began as early as 1990, when he was mayor of Shanghai. That year he led an economic and trade delegation to Hong Kong on a study visit, and from then until his retirement he visited Hong Kong a total of four times. He paid close attention to developments in Hong Kong, reading two Hong Kong newspapers daily to keep abreast of the latest situation."}

{'「如果香港搞不好⋯⋯」': "'If Hong Kong cannot be governed well...'"}

{'人民出版社在2011年出版的《朱鎔基講話實錄》，輯錄朱鎔基多篇重要講話，包括他 2002年底訪港期間，在禮賓府歡迎晚宴上發表的 22 分鐘講話。他談到香港管治和前途時，曾說：「香港的前途是光明的，我們總是以有香港為榮。我就不相信香港搞不好，如果香港搞不好，不單你們有責任，我們也有責任，香港回歸祖國在我們手裡搞壞了，那我們豈不成了民族罪人，不會的。」': 'The People\'s Publishing House\'s 2011 publication "Records of Zhu Rongji\'s Speeches" compiles many of his important addresses, including a 22-minute speech he delivered at a welcome banquet at Government House during his visit to Hong Kong at the end of 2002. When discussing Hong Kong\'s governance and future, he remarked: "Hong Kong\'s future is bright. We have always taken pride in Hong Kong. I refuse to believe Hong Kong cannot be governed well. If Hong Kong cannot be governed well, it would not only be your responsibility, but ours as well. If Hong Kong, having returned to the motherland, were messed up under our watch, we would become sinners of the nation — that will not happen."'}

{'朱鎔基也多次表明支持香港維持聯繫匯率制度。亞洲金融風暴期間，港元遭包括著名國際炒家索羅斯等狙擊，朱鎔基曾高調表明會「不惜一切代價，維護香港的繁榮穩定，保護它的聯繫匯率制度」。': 'Zhu Rongji also stated on multiple occasions his support for Hong Kong maintaining the linked exchange rate system. During the Asian financial crisis, when the Hong Kong dollar came under attack from speculators including the famous international financier George Soros, Zhu Rongji publicly declared that he would "spare no effort to safeguard Hong Kong\'s prosperity and stability and protect its linked exchange rate system."'}

{'早在擔任副總理期間，朱鎔基就已經公開支持香港的聯繫匯率制度。 1997年12月，他接見中國銀行和中國人民保險（集團）公司海外機構總經理會議代表，並發表題為「認真吸取亞洲金融危機的教訓」的演講。': 'As early as his time as vice-premier, Zhu Rongji had already publicly supported Hong Kong\'s linked exchange rate system. In December 1997, he met with representatives attending the conference of general managers of overseas branches of the Bank of China and the People\'s Insurance (Group) Company of China, and delivered a speech titled "Drawing Seriously the Lessons of the Asian Financial Crisis."'}

{'他提到「香港是靠自己成功地維持了聯繫匯率制度」，又說：「不要批評香港的聯繫匯率制度……我們只有支持香港特區政府所採取的一切措施……在這緊急的時候、大敵當前的時候，不能批評人家，只能支持，為他們鼓勁。」': 'He noted that "Hong Kong has, by its own efforts, successfully maintained the linked exchange rate system," and added: "We must not criticise Hong Kong\'s linked exchange rate system... We should only support all the measures taken by the Hong Kong SAR government... At this critical moment, with a formidable enemy at hand, we must not criticise but only support and encourage them."'}

{'朱鎔基當時又表示，香港與其他東南亞國家和地區相比，金融制度較為健全，香港房地產的問題亦不像泰國等國家般源於供過於求，而是地價過高導致房地產價格過高，因此香港經濟中泡沫經濟的成分相對較少，並表示對香港的前途充滿信心。': "At the time, Zhu Rongji also pointed out that, compared with other Southeast Asian countries and regions, Hong Kong's financial system was relatively sound, and Hong Kong's property problems were unlike those of countries such as Thailand, which stemmed from oversupply; in Hong Kong's case, high land prices had pushed property prices up, so there was relatively less of a bubble-element component in Hong Kong's economy. He expressed full confidence in Hong Kong's future."}
